vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm sets out to find A woman, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
🚶 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is back — found Lena.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 20s telling A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. The retelling is already better than the event.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Omar about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇯🇵 Japanese. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Patrick, Leonora, Lena, Hassan and Omar met them at the door — 5 put down. Patrick, Leonora, Lena, Hassan, Omar are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Leonora, Lena, Yuki, Hassan and Omar met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Leonora, Lena, Yuki, Hassan, Omar are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Ad Break falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Ad Break!

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Marcus taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Marcus passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Marcus, Henry, Amol and Yahya met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Marcus, Henry, Yahya are hurt.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Marcus — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Marcus chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Marcus Webb, 41 — an electrician. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Lucky Rock, Cold-Blooded.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
